data.data: Data: public build from RxNorm Current Prescribable 2026-09-08, Drugs@FDA brand names, DDInter bulk download (ddinter2.scbdd.com, 2024-05-21), SIDER 4.1; 169,673 interaction records; not synthetic.

internal_consistency.note: internal consistency: ground truth uses the same normalizer and table as retrieval, so recall/precision are 1.0 by construction
